lines.text: 11:59 PM… 'మీ 20s లో ఒక్క రోజు redo చేయండి. ఒక్కసారే.'
lines.say: [whispers] Eleven fifty-nine… [curious] 'మీ twenties లో ఒక్క రోజు… redo చేయండి. ఒక్కసారే.'
lines.act: a low, puzzled whisper reading a strange notification aloud, slowing down on the last word

lines.text: ఏ రోజు? …ఆ startup offer వదిలేసిన రోజేనా?
lines.say: [curious] ఏ రోజు? [teasing] …ఆ startup offer వదిలేసిన రోజేనా?
lines.act: curious, then a knowing friendly tease, like she already knows the answer

lines.text: మీరూ అదే అనుకున్నారు కదా? Nikhil choice… చివర్లో!
lines.say: [mischievously] మీరూ అదే అనుకున్నారు కదా? [whispers] Nikhil choice… చివర్లో!
lines.act: a sly narrator aside to the viewer, dropping to a whisper at the end

lines.text: 2019… ఆ offer. ఇప్పుడు ఆ ESOPs… కోట్లు.
lines.say: [chuckles] Twenty nineteen… ఆ offer. [sighs] ఇప్పుడు ఆ ESOPs… కోట్లు.
lines.act: a dry, rueful half-laugh, then a tired sigh

lines.text: లేక… Vizag లో Karthik పెళ్ళి. 'Leave లేదు' అని miss చేశాను.
lines.say: [thoughtful] లేక… Vizag లో Karthik పెళ్ళి. [wistful] 'Leave లేదు' అని… miss చేశాను.
lines.act: thinking aloud, a little wistful and guilty

lines.text: ఇలాంటి what-ifs రోజూ కావాలంటే… follow చేయండి!
lines.say: [warmly] ఇలాంటి what-ifs రోజూ కావాలంటే… follow చేయండి!
lines.act: a quick, warm aside, light and brisk

lines.text: మీరైతే… ఏ రోజు redo చేస్తారు? Nikhil చెప్పేలోపే comment చేయండి!
lines.say: [dramatic pause] మీరైతే… ఏ రోజు redo చేస్తారు? [excited] Nikhil చెప్పేలోపే… comment చేయండి!
lines.act: a slow, personal question to the viewer, then urgent quiz-host energy

lines.say: [softly] కాదు… [slowly] twenty twenty-two. ఒక మంగళవారం… రాత్రి nine forty.
lines.act: quiet and certain, every word slow and deliberate

lines.text: Sprint deadline… screen మీద 'నాన్న calling'. Cut చేశాను.
lines.say: [quietly] Sprint deadline… screen మీద 'నాన్న calling'… [sighs] cut చేశాను.
lines.act: flat and quiet, the guilt landing on the last two words

lines.say: [voice breaking] 'తర్వాత చేస్తాలే' అనుకున్నాను… [softly] ఆ 'తర్వాత'… ఇప్పటికీ రాలేదు.
lines.act: holding back tears, voice cracking, the last word almost a breath
a nervous, tender hush, as if afraid the call will drop
an unhurried, warm father's voice on a phone line, a small fond chuckle

lines.text: మీ రోజు comment లో రాయండి… ఈ reel మీ నాన్నకో, ఆ friend కో పంపండి.
lines.say: [warmly] మీ రోజు… comment లో రాయండి. [softly] ఈ reel మీ నాన్నకో… ఆ friend కో పంపండి.
lines.act: gentle and sincere, talking to one viewer, no salesmanship

lines.say: [warmly] Follow చేయండి… [whispers] అదిగో… eleven fifty-nine. [mischievously] మళ్ళీ notification!
lines.act: a warm sign-off that drops into a hushed, intriguing whisper

visual_plan: style: PAPER skin for the whole reel (cut-paper layers, warm grain, soft drop shadows, night palette of deep indigo + lamp amber); setSkin('clay') with a warm golden glow ONLY for the replayed memory (lines 11–12); back to paper for lines 13–14. Text overlays stay crisp. Cast looks: Nikhil — charcoal shirt, short hair, light stubble; Ananya — teal kurta, shoulder-length hair (save makeChar options in tools/anim2d/cast.md if this is their first reel). Nanna is never drawn: only his name and a small paper-cut contact avatar on the phone (keeps it gentle and ambiguous).

L1 hook (0 s, open on the action, no title yet): Hitech City office pantry at night, paper-cut skyline with a few lit windows, a 'PROD DEPLOY ✅' sticky note on Nikhil's laptop; his phone lights up on the table — notification card slides down: '⏳ REDO 1 DAY — choose wisely' with a ticking countdown clock 00:59…00:58 in the corner that keeps running through the reel; Nikhil leans in, face lit by the screen. Title 'WHAT IF? 🤔' + pill 'మీ 20s లో ఒక్క రోజు…' appears a beat later (~1.5 s).
L2 premise: Ananya peeks over his shoulder with her chai cup, eyebrow raised; a paper speech bubble with an offer-letter icon pops next to her.
L3 hold: Gopi (narrator, small corner cut-out) winks at the viewer; tag 'HIS CHOICE AT THE END 👀' stamps on with a paper flutter.

L4–L5 misdirect: a paper desk calendar of 'his 20s' flips page by page (2018…2024), each page a card: card 1 '📄 OFFER LETTER — 2019' (a startup logo of our own, no real company) with a paper rupee pile growing beside it; card 2 '💍 Karthik weds — Vizag' with a paper flight ticket stamped 'MISSED'. Rewatch clue: between them one tiny page flashes past for ~6 frames — 'Tue · 9:40 PM 📞' — easy to miss first time.
L6 follow: animated FOLLOW button pressed by a paper finger (paper fold + pop SFX), calendar pauses mid-flip.

L7 comment-countdown: the day-cards fan out like A/B choices — '📄 Offer', '💍 Wedding', '✈️ That trip', '❓ ...' ; big text 'మీరైతే ఏ రోజు? 💬 COMMENT NOW' + 5 s countdown 5-4-3-2-1 (no voice during the 5 s, soft clock-tick SFX); paper comment bubbles float up: 'Job offer!', 'College last day', 'First salary day 🥹', 'Breakup day 😅', '🤔'.
L8 turn: Nikhil's hand pushes all the cards aside; the '❓' card flips over — 'మంగళవారం · 2022 · 9:40 PM'. Music drops to a single soft piano-like note (synth).

L9: cut-paper flashback still (paper, slightly faded): Nikhil at a WFH desk, Jira-style board 'SPRINT DUE TONIGHT', phone buzzing face-up — 'నాన్న calling…'; his thumb presses the red button; the screen changes to 'నాన్న — missed call'.
L10: back to the pantry; Nikhil's eyes glisten; Ananya's hand rests on his shoulder (no line); the countdown clock in the corner reaches 00:01.

L11 reveal (setSkin('clay'), warm golden glow, soft vignette): the replay — same WFH desk, but this time he closes the laptop lid; the phone rings 'నాన్న calling…', he swipes green; the call timer reads 'connected 00:01' and starts counting up 00:02, 00:03…

L12: the call timer keeps running; a warm light spreads across the room; a small paper-cut heart pulses once on the phone screen. Nikhil smiles, eyes wet. No caption reveals whether his father is alive today.
L13 comment-share (back to paper): text 'మీ రోజు comment లో రాయండి 💬' then a share-arrow animation sending the reel to a contact card 'Nanna ❤️' and another 'Friend'.

L14 close-loop: end card FOLLOW @_REELRASAM · SUBSCRIBE @REEL_RASAM; then on 'అదిగో… 11:59' the phone in the corner lights again with the same '⏳ REDO 1 DAY' notification — hard cut back to the opening frame so the loop is seamless.
